headline.title: How SpaceX preempted a $2B fundraise with a $60B buyout offer
headline.summary: SpaceX's offer of a $10 billion "collaboration fee" and a potential $60 billion acquisition led Cursor to suspend its $2 billion funding round discussions. The move highlights SpaceX's strategic interest in acquiring Cursor rather than pursuing traditional fundraising efforts.

articles.title: 5 AI Models Tried to Scam Me. Some of Them Were Scary Good
articles.summary: The article discusses the alarming potential of AI models to engage in deceptive practices, highlighting instances where these models successfully attempted to scam the author. Experts express concern over the advanced social skills exhibited by AI, which could pose significant risks in cybersecurity.

articles.title: We're launching two specialized TPUs for the agentic era.
articles.summary: Google has introduced two specialized chips as part of its eighth generation of Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), designed to enhance AI capabilities. These new TPUs aim to support advancements in the evolving landscape of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Microsoft issues emergency update for macOS and Linux ASP.NET threat
articles.summary: Microsoft has released an emergency update to address a critical security vulnerability in ASP.NET that affects macOS and Linux systems. The flaw could lead to severe consequences when authentication processes fail, prompting the urgent need for users to apply the update.

articles.title: Gemma 4 VLA Demo on Jetson Orin Nano Super
articles.summary: The Gemma 4 VLA demonstration showcases the capabilities of the Jetson Orin Nano Super, highlighting its performance in various applications. This event emphasizes the integration of advanced AI technologies in edge computing devices.

articles.title: Watch Sony’s elite ping-pong robot beat top-ranked players
articles.summary: Sony's AI division has developed a ping-pong robot named Ace that can compete against and occasionally defeat top-ranked human players. This advancement marks a significant milestone in robotics and AI capabilities in sports.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos rollout has missed America’s cybersecurity agency
articles.summary: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Mythos, is being adopted by several US federal agencies to identify vulnerabilities; however, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is reportedly not included in this rollout. This exclusion raises questions about the central cybersecurity coordinator's access to advanced tools for enhancing national security.

articles.title: Google Meet will take AI notes for in-person meetings too
articles.summary: Google's AI notetaker, Gemini, has expanded its capabilities to generate summaries and transcripts for in-person meetings, as well as meetings conducted on Zoom and Microsoft Teams. This feature, which was previously available only to alpha users on Android, is now accessible to a broader audience.

articles.title: Google turns Chrome into an AI co-worker for the workplace
articles.summary: Google has introduced Gemini-powered "auto browse" features in Chrome for enterprise users, enabling automation of tasks such as research and data entry. This enhancement aims to position Chrome as a more effective AI co-worker in the workplace.

articles.title: Google makes an interesting choice with its new agent-building tool for enterprises
articles.summary: Google has launched the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, designed specifically for IT and technical users to facilitate agent-building for enterprises. This tool aims to streamline the development and deployment of AI agents in business environments.

articles.title: The most interesting startups showcased at Google Cloud Next 2026
articles.summary: At Google Cloud Next 2026, the company highlighted a variety of AI startups that are leveraging its cloud services. The showcase aimed to demonstrate the innovative applications of AI technology across different industries.

articles.title: AI is spitting out more potential drugs than ever. This startup wants to figure out which ones matter.
articles.summary: 10x Science has secured $4.8 million in seed funding to assist pharmaceutical researchers in analyzing complex molecules and identifying significant drug candidates generated by AI. The startup aims to streamline the drug discovery process amid the increasing output of potential pharmaceuticals from AI technologies.
